stocks:055550.KS.standing: One of South Korea's largest financial groups, owner of Shinhan Bank, Shinhan Card and insurance and brokerage arms. Its share tracks Korean interest rates, household credit and the won.
stocks:055550.KS.recent: The one story in the input about Shinhan's own business was a plan, still at the looking stage, to let Japanese visitors pay in Korea with yen stablecoins. Nothing in it accounts for the fall in the share.

poly-will-a-us-iran-deal-in-2026-include.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether a US-Iran agreement reached in 2026 has Iran hand over its stockpile of enriched uranium, the material at the centre of the nuclear dispute and of any settlement between the two.
poly-will-a-us-iran-deal-in-2026-include.recent: Nothing in these weeks put Iran's uranium on a negotiating table. Iran offered to reopen Hormuz against the US blockade, and Russia sought a mediation role. Meanwhile the Pentagon readied strike plans for after the midterms, and the US pulled nonessential staff from Saudi Arabia.

stocks:300750.SZ.standing: Contemporary Amperex Technology, the Ningde company listed in Shenzhen and the world's largest maker of electric-vehicle batteries. Carmakers from Tesla to BYD's rivals buy its cells, so its share tracks the EV and grid-storage build-out.
stocks:300750.SZ.recent: It reported a quarterly profit of 21.2 billion yuan, and its shares fell 15% anyway, part of a broader selloff that repriced China's tech stocks on their valuations rather than their earnings.

stocks:BARC.L.standing: Britain's second-largest bank by assets, combining a UK high-street bank and the Barclaycard business with one of the few European investment banks still competing on Wall Street. Its share price follows both UK rates and trading revenue.
stocks:BARC.L.recent: Barclays said it would cut 5,000 jobs, about 5% of its staff, as AI starts creating efficiency, while paying shareholders £500 million. A day later it vowed to redeploy staff to offset the pain of the cuts.

poly-will-deepseek-ipo-by-december-31-20.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if DeepSeek, the Hangzhou AI lab spun out of the hedge fund High-Flyer, lists its shares before 2028. A listing would open China's most closely watched AI lab to public shareholders.

poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Democrats control the US Senate after the 2026 midterm elections. The Senate confirms judges and cabinet officers, so whoever holds it decides who a president can appoint.
poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.recent: The one American election story of the fortnight came from Washington: two ex-FBI officials were charged with lying to Congress about the Hunter Biden laptop probe, 11 days before the midterms. Nothing in it bears on individual Senate races, and it does not account for what traders are paying.

stocks:LNG.standing: The largest exporter of liquefied natural gas in the United States, from terminals at Sabine Pass in Louisiana and Corpus Christi in Texas. It sells most of its output on long-term contracts to buyers in Europe and Asia.

stocks:VTRS.standing: A generic drugmaker formed in 2020 when Mylan merged with Pfizer's Upjohn unit. It sells off-patent brands such as Lipitor and Viagra, and supplies low-cost HIV medicines to public health systems worldwide.

stocks:7782.T.standing: The shares of Sincere Co., a Japanese company listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and priced in yen. The quote tracks what investors pay for one share of the company's own business.

stocks:CMCSA.standing: America's largest cable operator, selling Xfinity broadband, TV and mobile, and the owner of NBCUniversal's studios, Peacock and theme parks. Its broadband subscriber count is the figure its shareholders watch most closely.
stocks:CMCSA.recent: Comcast reported losing 144,000 US broadband customers last quarter. It blamed rivals' cheap prices, which it called "irrational", rather than its own service.

poly-bank-of-mexico-decreases-interest-r.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Banco de México cuts its overnight rate by a quarter point after November. That rate sets borrowing costs across Mexico and the yield gap that draws foreign money into the peso.
poly-bank-of-mexico-decreases-interest-r.recent: The fortnight's rate news was about the Fed: Warsh withheld guidance and called AI a shock to the economy, and the Fed was set for a hawkish pause. None of it concerns Banxico's own decision or accounts for this contract's price.

poly-venezuela-election-scheduled-by-dec.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Venezuela's authorities formally schedule a national election before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on a vote being called, not on one being held.
poly-venezuela-election-scheduled-by-dec.recent: Venezuelans marched in Caracas on Thursday to demand a presidential election date, which is the exact outcome this contract pays on. None of the reporting since shows any authority answering them with a date.

poly-us-iran-ceasefire-continues-through.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the ceasefire between the United States and Iran survives until the US midterm elections. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on strikes, threats and mediation.
poly-us-iran-ceasefire-continues-through.recent: Washington pulled nonessential staff from Saudi Arabia, and Trump said the US may strike Iran as soon as Sunday. The bets recovered as reports placed CENTCOM's renewed strike options after the 3 November midterms, while Iran offered to reopen Hormuz against the US blockade.

stocks:000660.KS.standing: South Korea's second-largest chipmaker and one of the world's two biggest makers of memory chips. It leads in high-bandwidth memory, the stacked DRAM beside AI accelerators, so its shares trade on AI data-centre spending.
stocks:000660.KS.recent: On Oct 13, Samsung and SK Hynix dragged South Korea's benchmark down 5.5% on doubts over AI spending and competition from Chinese memory rivals. On Oct 23 the company cancelled a Solidigm listing worth up to $15 billion. That keeps Intel's former NAND business, now its US flash arm, in-house as AI data centres drive flash demand, and its shares jumped 5%.

stocks:MRNA.standing: The Massachusetts biotech built on messenger RNA, the technology behind its Covid-19 vaccine. As Covid sales have shrunk, its value has come to rest on whether mRNA works against cancer and other diseases.
stocks:MRNA.recent: The shares climbed into the long-awaited reveal of Moderna and Merck's melanoma vaccine trial, then fell when it came. The shot cut relapse or death 42%, a result oncologists cheered even as it sent the stock down, and the full data went before ESMO the next day.

stocks:MRK.standing: Shares of Merck & Co., the US drugmaker whose cancer immunotherapy Keytruda is among the world's best-selling medicines. That makes the stock a running verdict on how Merck replaces it in its oncology pipeline.
stocks:MRK.recent: Merck's news this fortnight was its melanoma vaccine with Moderna: the shot cut relapse or death 42% in a phase 3 trial, reported on 2026-10-23, after the chart's last reading. Moderna's shares fell on the data. Nothing in the input explains Merck's own price over the window.

stocks:C.standing: One of the four largest US banks, and the most international of them, with operations in about 90 countries. Its shares trade on interest margins, credit losses and a multi-year overhaul ordered by US regulators.

stocks:FM.TO.standing: A Vancouver-based copper miner listed in Toronto, producing mainly from the Kansanshi and Sentinel mines in Zambia. Its shares move with the copper price and with the fate of its Cobre Panamá mine in Panama.
stocks:FM.TO.recent: The one company-specific item in the fortnight was First Quantum preparing to seek state-backed tax breaks under Argentina's RIGI regime for Taca Taca, a $5.25 billion copper project. Nothing in it accounts for the fall in the share.

stocks:INTC.standing: Intel designs PC and server processors and, unlike most chip companies, makes them in its own fabs. It is the US government's main bet on rebuilding leading-edge chip manufacturing at home.
stocks:INTC.recent: The FCC's loosely drawn ban on foreign-made robots forced Intel to seek a waiver for the automated guided vehicles that move wafers through its fabs, and it got one. That is the only news here about Intel's own business, and it does not account for the fall in its shares.

stocks:RHHBY.standing: Roche, the Basel drug and diagnostics group, priced in dollars. It is the world's largest maker of diagnostic tests, and its earnings rest on cancer medicines and the multiple sclerosis drug Ocrevus.

stocks:NVS.standing: Novartis, the Basel-based drugmaker, as its shares trade in New York. Its earnings rest on a few patented medicines, so trial readouts and patent expiries move it more than the economy does.
stocks:NVS.recent: Novartis's pill remibrutinib cut multiple sclerosis relapses 35.2% and 31.2% against teriflunomide in pivotal trials, results that landed after the chart's last close. It trails Roche's rival BTK inhibitor on efficacy but has a better safety profile, and in the first new MS drug class in years a liver-safety edge can decide which one patients get.

stocks:SNY.standing: The Nasdaq-listed American depositary shares of Sanofi, the Paris drugmaker. Its earnings lean heavily on Dupixent, an antibody for eczema and asthma, alongside one of the world's largest vaccine businesses.
stocks:SNY.recent: Sanofi settled an EU antitrust probe in mid-October, the only news about its own business in the fortnight. Nothing reported gives the terms of the settlement or ties it to the share price.

poly-will-any-country-join-the-mecca-agr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if any further country formally joins the Mecca Agreement before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on the pact widening beyond its founding signatories.

poly-will-the-republicans-win-the-texas-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Republican candidate wins Texas's US Senate race in November 2026. Texas has not elected a Democrat to the Senate since 1988, so the price shows how far traders bet against that record.

stocks:D05.SI.standing: Southeast Asia's largest bank by assets, headquartered in Singapore and partly owned by the state investor Temasek. Its earnings rise and fall with interest rates, so its shares track the cost of money across the region.

stocks:BEN.standing: The listed parent of Franklin Templeton, one of the largest US asset managers. It earns fees on the money it runs, so its shares rise and fall with market levels and with whether clients add to its funds or pull out.
stocks:BEN.recent: The one story in the fortnight about Franklin's own business was about its tokenized fund: the firm keeps the power to freeze about $200 million of its own tokens. It came after the window closed, and nothing in the input accounts for the share's slide before then.

stocks:ASML.standing: The Dutch company that builds the lithography machines chipmakers use to print circuits onto silicon, and the only maker of the extreme-ultraviolet tools that the most advanced chips require.
stocks:ASML.recent: Nothing reported in these weeks accounts for the share price. Customers are asking for lithography tools as far out as 2029 and 2030, and equipment sales to China rose 109%, lifting China's share of sales from 14% to 23% despite a US push for export curbs.

stocks:7751.T.standing: Shares of the Tokyo-based maker of cameras, office printers and medical scanners, which also builds the lithography tools used to pattern chips. Most of its sales are abroad, so a weaker yen lifts its earnings.

stocks:7731.T.standing: Japan's camera and optics maker, listed in Tokyo, which also builds lithography steppers for chip and flat-panel factories. Its earnings swing with consumer camera demand and with the spending cycle of display and semiconductor plants.

poly-cuban-regime-falls-in-2026.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Cuba's communist government loses power before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, set against a one-party state that has outlasted decades of US sanctions.

stocks:GS.standing: Shares of Goldman Sachs, the New York investment bank that advises on mergers, underwrites stock and bond sales and trades for clients. Its earnings rise and fall with dealmaking and market turnover.

stocks:NOK.standing: Nokia makes the radio, optical and IP networking equipment that mobile operators and data-centre builders buy, listed in Helsinki and traded in New York. Its share tracks operator capital spending and the cloud networking it has pushed into.

poly-will-david-lisnard-win-the-2027-fre.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if David Lisnard, the mayor of Cannes and founder of the Nouvelle Énergie party, wins France's 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

stocks:HSAI.standing: A Shanghai maker of lidar, the laser sensors that let cars and robots map their surroundings, listed on Nasdaq. Chinese carmakers are its main buyers, and US scrutiny of Chinese tech firms hangs over the listing.
stocks:HSAI.recent: The one piece of company news came after the slide: Hesai launched Kosmo, a lidar built for robots, on the back of 142,400 robot lidars shipped in the second quarter, up 193.4%. Nothing reported about Hesai's own business accounts for the fall in its shares.

wiki-flavio-bolsonaro.standing: The daily readership of the Wikipedia article on Flávio Bolsonaro, the Rio de Janeiro senator and eldest son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, who carries his father's movement on Brazil's right.
wiki-flavio-bolsonaro.recent: Flávio Bolsonaro led the first round 47.03% to Lula's 45.16%, then lost the runoff in what Reuters called a shock upset. The final fortnight brought a pension-fraud trail through one Águas Claras room that registered 90 companies, and Meta's admission that its AI generated images favouring him.

stocks:JPM.standing: The largest bank in the United States by assets, spanning Chase's consumer branches, corporate lending and one of Wall Street's biggest investment banks. Its results are read as a check on American borrowers.
stocks:JPM.recent: The CBN granted JPMorgan approval-in-principle to set up a merchant bank in Nigeria, the first licensing step for a firm present in Lagos since 1961. That came after the series closed, and nothing else in the fortnight about the bank's own business accounts for the share price.

stocks:MS.standing: Morgan Stanley, the New York investment bank and one of Wall Street's largest wealth managers. Its profits lean on trading, dealmaking and fees on client assets, so its share tracks how busy and how high markets are.
stocks:MS.recent: The one item in the fortnight about the bank's own business had Morgan Stanley, alongside Goldman Sachs and Wells Fargo, calling tokenization a growth play rather than a threat. Nothing in it accounts for the fall in the share.

poly-will-gavin-newsom-win-the-2028-us-p.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Gavin Newsom, the Democratic governor of California, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, in cents on the dollar.

poly-will-likud-win-the-most-seats-in-th.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Likud, Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing party, wins more seats than any other party in the 120-member Knesset at Israel's 2026 general election.
poly-will-likud-win-the-most-seats-in-th.recent: In the run-up to Tuesday's vote, Netanyahu drew an EU condemnation over a settler attack on diplomats, won Trump's endorsement, held a secret meeting with Hegseth that excluded the army chief, and ordered Hebron cordoned after 5 Israelis were wounded. None of it, read alone, accounts for the falling price on Likud.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the Florida Republican who became secretary of state, wins his party's 2028 presidential nomination. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, in cents on the dollar.

poly-will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if American forces invade Iran before 2027. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it reacts to troop moves, strikes and diplomacy between Washington and Tehran.
poly-will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.recent: The Pentagon has drawn up options to renew strikes on Iran after the 3 November midterms, and Trump says the US may strike as soon as Sunday. Washington pulled nonessential staff from Saudi Arabia as Iran named data centres, cables and AI sites in 7 Gulf states as targets. Every reported plan is for strikes, not an invasion.

stocks:VWAGY.standing: Volkswagen's shares, priced in dollars on the US over-the-counter market. Europe's biggest carmaker owns Audi, Porsche and Skoda, and its earnings ride on sales in China and on tariffs between Europe and the US.
stocks:VWAGY.recent: Audi, the group's premium brand, will build 200,000 cars a year in Georgia, a plant Trump claims as a tariff win at Perry. The announcement came after the latest close shown, so it does not account for the slide.

poly-will-peter-obi-win-the-2027-nigeria.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Peter Obi, the former Anambra governor who ran third in 2023, wins Nigeria's presidency in 2027. Its price is what traders will pay on an opposition upset of the ruling APC.
poly-will-peter-obi-win-the-2027-nigeria.recent: The fortnight's one Nigerian story was Tinubu opening the APC's 2027 campaign in Kaduna, in the north, with petrol at about 1,400 naira a litre in September after fuel-subsidy removal and the naira's devaluation. It came after this contract's swings and does not account for them.

poly-will-the-republican-party-hold-exac.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Republicans hold exactly 53 of the US Senate's 100 seats after the 2026 midterms, the majority they won in 2024. It prices one precise outcome, not simply control of the chamber.
poly-will-the-republican-party-hold-exac.recent: The fortnight's US political news was the charging of 2 ex-FBI officials with lying to Congress about the Hunter Biden laptop probe, 11 days before the midterms. None of it bears on individual Senate races or accounts for the price.

poly-france-declares-state-of-emergency-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether France declares a state of emergency, the 1955 power letting the government ban gatherings, restrict movement and order searches without a judge. Paris used it after the 2015 attacks.

poly-will-the-democrats-win-the-ohio-sen.standing: What traders on Polymarket pay for a contract that settles at 100 if a Democrat wins Ohio's 2026 US Senate race. Ohio has leaned Republican in recent statewide contests, so the seat bears on which party controls the Senate.

stocks:LLOY.L.standing: Britain's largest mortgage lender, owner of Halifax and Bank of Scotland. Almost all its lending is domestic, so its shares trade as a bet on UK interest rates, house prices and household credit.

poly-us-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-throu.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the ceasefire between the United States and Iran survives to its deadline. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, so it moves on every strike threat and every offer between the two.
poly-us-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-throu.recent: Iran offered to reopen Hormuz shipping against the US blockade, and the Pentagon's reported strike plans wait until after the 3 November midterms, beyond this contract's date. Against that, the US pulled nonessential staff from Saudi Arabia, Trump said a strike could come as soon as Sunday, and Iran says two supertankers hit mines.

poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Democrats win a majority in the US House of Representatives at the 2026 midterm elections. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, and House control decides whether a president's agenda can pass.
poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.recent: The fortnight's one US story was in Washington, where 2 ex-FBI officials were charged with lying to Congress about the Hunter Biden laptop probe, 11 days before the midterms. Nothing in it bears on which party wins House seats, and it does not account for the price.

poly-netanyahu-out-before-2027-684-719-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Benjamin Netanyahu stops being Israel's prime minister before 2027. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves with coalition crises, court cases and election timing.

poly-sudan-civil-war-ceasefire-by-decemb.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Sudan's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces agree a ceasefire before 2026 ends. The war, fought since April 2023, has driven the world's largest displacement crisis.

poly-billionaire-one-time-wealth-tax-pas.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether California enacts a tax on billionaires' net worth in 2026. The state is home to more billionaires than any other US state, and the threat of them moving away dominates the argument over it.

wiki-meta-platforms.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on Meta Platforms, the Menlo Park company that owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp and builds its own AI models.
wiki-meta-platforms.recent: The peak came the day after Meta claimed its new Muse model had reached the AI frontier after 14 months of rebuilding. The following week New Mexico won $25 billion from it over 43 million deception violations tied to Cambridge Analytica, and Meta created nonvoting shares that Zuckerberg can partly sell freely.

wiki-united-states.standing: Daily reads of the English Wikipedia article on the United States, one of the encyclopedia's most visited pages. Rises in it tend to track moments when American politics or power become the world's story.
wiki-united-states.recent: 11 days before the midterms, ex-FBI officials were charged over 2023 testimony, and the Justice Department sued over Alaska's Senate certification in a suit that applies only if the Republican loses. The same day, a court filing's "a/k/a" led Trump to demand that Omar resign.

poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether shipping through the Strait of Hormuz returns to normal by year's end. The strait carries most Gulf oil and gas exports, so this is a bet on the region's energy supply reaching the world.
poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.recent: Iran's Revolutionary Guard reported mines hitting tankers through late October, seven in one night, and its strait authority blacklisted 122 ships. Araghchi said Hormuz would never be managed as before the war; CENTCOM's claim to have escorted 1.5 billion barrels through cleared routes cuts the other way.

wiki-vladimir-putin.standing: How many people read the Wikipedia article on Vladimir Putin each day. He has led Russia as president or prime minister since 1999, and the count jumps when he goes to war, negotiates or meets a foreign leader.
wiki-vladimir-putin.recent: Kyiv's 2-day pause on refinery strikes went unanswered, Zelenskyy says, as Germany and Ukraine pressed Putin to join a full energy-sector truce. Putin then freed Stephen Hubbard during Steve Witkoff's visit and proposed a three-way summit with no Ukrainian seat. Russia said it is ready to resume talks by mid-November.

poly-xi-jinping-out-before-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Xi Jinping stops being China's paramount leader before 2027. Xi has held power since 2012 and scrapped presidential term limits in 2018, so the price is a wager on an abrupt break in the Communist Party's leadership.

poly-will-anthropic-have-the-best-ai-mod.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic holds the top spot on a public AI model leaderboard when October ends. The ranking can change hands whenever a rival lab releases a stronger model.

poly-will-likud-win-30-34-seats-in-the-2.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Likud, Benjamin Netanyahu's party, wins between 30 and 34 of the Knesset's 120 seats. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, and Likud's size sets how many partners Netanyahu needs to govern.
poly-will-likud-win-30-34-seats-in-the-2.recent: The run-up to Tuesday's vote brought Trump's endorsement of Netanyahu, an unannounced visit from US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, and a Hebron lockdown Netanyahu ordered after 5 Israelis were wounded. None of it shows whether bettors moved Likud's tally above this band or below it.

wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on Benjamin Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving prime minister. It rises with his elections, wars and trials, which have shaped Israel's politics for three decades.
wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.recent: Trump endorsed Netanyahu for the 27 October vote and tied it to the war on Iran; a day later his 3-page doctrine made preemptive war official policy. After a Hebron gunfight killed 2 soldiers, he ordered Hebron cordoned and 2,200 people were displaced, while Israel's army chief reportedly warned Washington off striking Iran.

poly-will-anthropic-ipo-by-november-30-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI company behind the Claude models, lists its shares on a public stock exchange by 30 November 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-will-alexandria-ocasio-cortez-win-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, the New York congresswoman, wins the 2028 US presidential election. It prices her chances against a wide Democratic field before a single primary vote is cast.

poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the ceasefire between Israel and Iran is still in force on Oct 31. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it reacts to strike threats, Gulf shipping and diplomacy.
poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.recent: Israel's army chief, Eyal Zamir, reportedly warned Washington that a joint strike on Iran would disrupt Tuesday's election, even as Netanyahu pressed for one before polling day and Trump said the US may strike as soon as Sunday. Days earlier, Iran offered to reopen Hormuz shipping.

stocks:AMD.standing: A Santa Clara chip designer selling x86 processors for PCs and servers and Instinct accelerators for AI data centres. Its shares price how much AI spending buyers will steer away from Nvidia.

stocks:JD.standing: One of China's largest online retailers, and unlike most rivals it owns its warehouses and delivery fleet. Its Nasdaq-listed shares trade on Chinese household spending and on Beijing's stance toward platform companies.
stocks:JD.recent: JD ended deposit pre-sales for its 18th Singles' Day, so shoppers no longer pay weeks ahead to lock in a festival discount. It also said running its ad models on Huawei's Kunpeng chips cut inference latency 15%. Neither announcement explains why the shares gave ground across the fortnight.

stocks:AVGO.standing: Designs the custom AI chips and data-centre networking silicon that Google, Meta and other cloud giants build on, and owns VMware's software. Its share price is a read on how much the largest tech firms spend on AI.
stocks:AVGO.recent: Broadcom joined Verizon and 7 other issuers in refusing to have their shares tokenized under the SEC framework, a dispute over how its stock trades rather than over its business, and nothing else in the fortnight's news accounts for the fall.

poly-will-xavier-becerra-win-the-califor.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Xavier Becerra, former US health secretary and California attorney general, wins the 2026 race for governor of California, the most populous US state and its largest economy.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-republic.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if JD Vance, the US vice president, becomes the Republican nominee for the 2028 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome against his party rivals.

wiki-west-bank.standing: The land between Israel and the Jordan River, occupied by Israel since 1967. About three million Palestinians live there alongside hundreds of thousands of Israeli settlers, and the Palestinian Authority governs only parts of it.
wiki-west-bank.recent: After attacks near Hebron killed 2 soldiers and wounded 5 Israelis, Netanyahu ordered the city cordoned. The operation that followed has driven out more than 3,100 Palestinians, which the UN says raises concerns of ethnic cleansing. It followed a week of settler attacks on olive pickers, EU diplomats and a 78-year-old French mayor in Taybeh.

poly-will-luiz-inacio-lula-da-silva-win-.standing: A Polymarket parlay that pays only if three separate things happen: Lula wins Brazil's presidency, Gadi Eisenkot becomes Israel's prime minister, and Democrats take the US Senate. If any one leg fails, it pays nothing.
poly-will-luiz-inacio-lula-da-silva-win-.recent: The Israeli leg is the one the news carried: polls put Eisenkot 8 to 10 points ahead of Netanyahu going into Tuesday's vote, despite Trump endorsing Netanyahu and Pete Hegseth's unannounced visit to him days before the election. None of the reporting here touches Lula's race or the Senate.

poly-will-no-listed-leader-be-out-before.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out only if every national leader on its list is still in office at the start of 2027. One resignation, ouster or death among them settles it the other way, so it prices the combined risk.

wiki-pakistan.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on Pakistan, the nuclear-armed South Asian state of more than 240 million people. It shows when world events send people looking for the country's basics.
wiki-pakistan.recent: At least 20 children died when a school roof collapsed in Peshawar, and Pakistan ordered school inspections. In Tehran, army chief Asim Munir was told no enriched nuclear material will leave Iran amid a US peace deal deadlock. At home, a Rs114-a-litre petrol levy drew a Jamaat-i-Islami threat to march on Islamabad.
